quality_flags: Only protein_coding genes are shipped (19938 symbols), so TPM column sums are 776405-978224 rather than the full-transcriptome 1e6. Never rescale them to 1e6.

24 gene symbols occur more than once in GENCODE v36 protein_coding rows (ACTL10, AKAP17A, ASMT, ASMTL, CD99, CRLF2, CSF2RA, DHRSX, GTPBP6, IL3RA, IL9R, MATR3, P2RY8, PDE11A, PLCXD1, POLR2J3, PPP2R3B, SHOX, SLC25A6, SMIM40, TMSB15B, VAMP7, WASH6P, ZBED1); their rows are summed, which differs from taking only the first row.
3 recurrent-tumour samples have no paired adjacent tissue and stay in the full cohort only.
counts are unstranded read counts; no library-size normalisation is applied here.
Sample identifiers are 16-character TCGA sample barcodes, not 28-character aliquot barcodes.
The clinical diagnosis table is not shipped; only sample-level fields are included.
